scope: One exploratory, baseline-path local-high and trial-capacity sensitivity. No new account or policy-return claim.
anchor: For a live-stock mobile candidate, H is max of comparable closes from the last actual buy OPEN date inclusive through the observation strictly before decision CLOSE. Empty H is unproved. Compare current C>H before adding current C to H.
exit_anchor: Retain the latest completed full-stock campaign or mobile-only subcycle high H_exit, by actual flat timestamp, with full-stock campaign winning ties. This includes mobile-flat while tiny core remains and core-only completed campaigns. H_exit uses closes from first actual OPEN through dates strictly before final flat OPEN. It persists across CP1/E0 resets in the same price-source segment. Success and failure both retain the anchor; previous trading cash sign is analysis only.
initial: An actual flat-to-new-stock first candidate remains trial, even if market proof predates funding. Original core orders remain unchanged. Subsequent mobile expansion requires original fresh CP1, original I protection and every still-live mobile layer's previously frozen protection alive before considering new evidence, strict H break and H_exit recovery if present.
trial: One original trial authorization per baseline stock campaign: if its first funded layer is CORE it has consumed that authorization; otherwise first MOBILE is shrunk to original LR1 .25% decisionNAV all-in risk, using original decision I floor and original fees/slippage. Repeated unproved new mobile orders in a live campaign receive no new trial allocation. A mobile-only restart with core alive may obtain one new trial after actual mobile-flat, subject to retained exit anchor; quantify separately.
quantity: Keep original mobile role and exit floor. q<=actual original fill, original cap and legal unit. Pure static first-trial q is min of original actual q, CORE risk cap at decision reference and at actual OPEN with decision-known I floor transformed only by already-audited factor. All original capital/risk/cash/ranking constraints remain conceptually, never add freed cash. Changed factor/source/invalid I floor is unknown, not silently zero in primary totals.
sensitivity: For known quantities only, removed-negative=-cut*min(original layer net,0), removed-positive=cut*max(original layer net,0), delta=-cut*original layer net. Original exits, mark, AR and fees scale mechanically; this is not exact new money accounting, an avoided-loss estimate or tradable NAV.
exception: No higher-low exception is selected. It is a separate candidate needing a causal pivot definition; it may only restore trial permission, never bypass retained mature-proof requirement.
mothers: all fixed original 83/94 tail members, exact baseline correspondences and unmatched explicit
stop: Stop before account engineering if original fresh-CP1 proof is largely redundant, broad losses precede proof, or static strong-window winner loss outweighs saved negative contribution. No new thresholds or case selection after outcomes.
